QuestInfo.name: [Easter Events] Decorate the Golden Egg!
QuestInfo.0: You've received #b#t3994511##k and #b#t3994512##k. How are you supposed to use these?! #p9010010# might know.
QuestInfo.1:
Cassandra says that she saw Gaga coloring Easter Eggs and hiding them. Cassandra says that she wants to color Easter Eggs too, but she's not very good at it.
She says that she'll give you #b#t3994511##k and #b#t3994512##k if you'll help decorate the egg.

Hold on to #b#t3994511##k and #b#t3994512##k for 30 minutes so that you can give the fancifully decorated egg to Cassandra.
QuestInfo.2: You've done a bang-up job on the Easter Egg! Cassandra is sure to love this! Take it to her quick, before you break it on accident!
